**Delivers** (from the Outline, claims table): Fig. 1 (setting + headline k-curve inset), Figs. 2-6 (C1-C5), Tables 1-5 (C0..C6), appendix figure A1 (spectra) and the appendix per-case figures that the main claims cite. # figtab-repo: figures and tables

Every figure/table of the paper is drawn by a script in `figs/` from result files of `experiment-repo` (`results/*.csv`, schema in `figs/data.py`; a missing file or column stops the script). No data are typed in or synthesised here.

| output | script | claim |
|---|---|---|
| Fig. 2 `fig2_main.pdf` | `figs/fig2_main.py` | C1 error and closure vs k, both predictors (PPCA, best simple) |
| Fig. 3 `fig3_gap.pdf` | `figs/fig3_gap.py` | C2 greedy vs random, paired |
| Fig. A1 `figA1_spectra.pdf` | `figs/figA1_spectra.py` | C0 spectra |
| Fig. 5 `fig5_theory.pdf` | `figs/fig5_theory.py` | C4 predicted vs empirical reducible risk |
| Table 1 `table1_datasets.tex` | `figs/table1_datasets.py` | C0 |
| Table 4 `table4_theory.tex` | `figs/table4_theory.py` | C4 |
| Figs. 1, 4, 6, 7, Tables 2, 3, 5 | to come (waiting for result files) | C0, C3-C6 (Outline rev. 2: Fig. 5 = three tiers in one panel, Fig. 6 starts as a table, Fig. 7 = history sweep, appendix first) |

Run: `python figs/fig2_main.py --results <results dir> --out out`. Each PDF gets a `<name>.json` sidecar (inputs' hashes, split, predictor, selectors, n families/models/targets).
`figs/venue.py` holds the venue's widths and minimum type size (set to NeurIPS 2026: 5.5 in column, 7 pt minimum in figures, 8 pt in tables; `--draft` only used while unset). `tools/check_fonts.py FIG.pdf MIN_PT` verifies the smallest printed text and that no Type 3 font is embedded.
Colours: Okabe-Ito, one colour per method across all figures (`figs/style.py`).

Delivery: finished PDFs/`.tex` and these scripts go to `figures/`, `tables/` (and `figures/src/`) of `paper-repo` `dev`; this table is the figure/table-to-script map for the reproduction notes.

"""Load result files from experiment-repo and fail loudly on a missing column."""
import os
import pandas as pd

REQUIRED = {
    "curves": ["dataset", "split", "selector", "predictor", "k", "metric", "mean", "ci_lo", "ci_hi",
               "n_families", "n_models", "n_targets"],
    "refs": ["dataset", "split", "reference", "metric", "value"],
    "closure": ["dataset", "split", "selector", "predictor", "k", "C_lobo", "C_lobo_lo", "C_lobo_hi"],
    "kstar": ["dataset", "level", "reference", "kstar", "censored", "r_eff", "h1_outcome"],
    "gap": ["dataset", "comparison", "k", "gap", "ci_lo", "ci_hi"],
    "bias": ["dataset", "split", "k", "stratum", "signed_bias", "ci_lo", "ci_hi", "n"],
    "theory": ["dataset", "tier", "k", "predicted_reducible", "empirical_reducible", "ci_lo", "ci_hi"],
    "theory_gap": ["dataset", "tier", "median_rel_gap"],
    "coherence": ["dataset", "fit_id", "k", "gap_random_greedy", "coherence"],
    "datasets": ["dataset", "n_models", "n_tasks", "density", "dense_pool_models", "dense_pool_tasks", "n_families"],
    "spectra": ["dataset", "component", "explained_variance_share"],
}


def load(resdir, name):
    for ext, rd in ((".csv", pd.read_csv), (".parquet", pd.read_parquet)):
        p = os.path.join(resdir, name + ext)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            df = rd(p)
            miss = [c for c in REQUIRED[name] if c not in df.columns]
            if miss:
                raise SystemExit(f"{p}: missing columns {miss}")
            return df, p
    raise SystemExit(f"{resdir}/{name}.csv|parquet not found (delivered by experiment-repo)")

"""Fig. 2 (claim C1): error and closure C(k) against k, grouped K-fold, one column per data regime.

Top row: standardised RMSE on the unrun benchmarks with floor/ceiling references.
Bottom row: closure C(k) against the primary LOBO reference, 0.8/0.9/0.95 levels, r_eff marked.
Datasets are separate columns and never pooled.
"""
import argparse, numpy as np
import style, venue
from data import load
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument("--results", required=True); p.add_argument("--out", default="out")
p.add_argument("--datasets", nargs="+", default=["mteb_eng", "helm_mmlu"])
p.add_argument("--selectors", nargs="+", default=["greedy_A", "random"])
p.add_argument("--predictors", nargs="+", default=["ppca", "best_simple"]); p.add_argument("--split", default="grouped")
p.add_argument("--draft", action="store_true")
a = p.parse_args()
PRED_LS = ["-", "--", ":"]
v = venue.get(a.draft)
size = style.setup(v["TEXT_WIDTH_IN"], v["MIN_FONT_PT"], aspect=0.58)
cur, p1 = load(a.results, "curves"); ref, p2 = load(a.results, "refs")
clo, p3 = load(a.results, "closure"); ks, p4 = load(a.results, "kstar")

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, len(a.datasets), figsize=size, sharex="col", squeeze=False)
meta = {}
for j, ds in enumerate(a.datasets):
    ax, bx = axs[0, j], axs[1, j]
    c = cur[(cur.dataset == ds) & (cur.split == a.split) & (cur.metric == "std_rmse")]
    cl = clo[(clo.dataset == ds) & (clo.split == a.split)]
    for s in a.selectors:
        for pi, pr in enumerate(a.predictors):
            d = c[(c.selector == s) & (c.predictor == pr)].sort_values("k")
            e = cl[(cl.selector == s) & (cl.predictor == pr)].sort_values("k")
            # colour = selector, line style / fill = predictor (first predictor solid, filled markers)
            kw = dict(color=style.COLORS[s], marker=style.MARKERS[s], ls=PRED_LS[pi], mfc=style.COLORS[s] if pi == 0 else "white",
                      label=f"{style.LABELS[s]}, {style.PRED_LABELS.get(pr, pr)}")
            ax.plot(d.k, d["mean"], **kw); ax.fill_between(d.k, d.ci_lo, d.ci_hi, color=kw["color"], alpha=0.15, lw=0)
            bx.plot(e.k, e.C_lobo, **kw); bx.fill_between(e.k, e.C_lobo_lo, e.C_lobo_hi, color=kw["color"], alpha=0.15, lw=0)
    r = ref[(ref.dataset == ds) & (ref.split == a.split) & (ref.metric == "std_rmse")]
    for name, st in style.REF_STYLE.items():
        row = r[r.reference == name]
        if len(row):
            ax.axhline(row.value.iloc[0], lw=0.9, **st)
    for lev in (0.8, 0.9, 0.95):
        bx.axhline(lev, color="0.7", lw=0.5 if lev != 0.9 else 0.9, ls="-")
    reff = ks[(ks.dataset == ds)].r_eff.iloc[0]
    for x in (ax, bx):
        x.axvline(reff, color="0.5", lw=0.8, ls="-", alpha=0.6)
    ax.text(reff, 0.98, " r_eff", transform=ax.get_xaxis_transform(), va="top", ha="left", color="0.35")
    ax.set_ylabel("standardised RMSE")
    bx.set_ylabel("closure $C(k)$"); bx.set_xlabel("benchmarks run, $k$")
    bx.set_ylim(None, 1.02)
    n = c.iloc[0]
    ax.set_title(style.DATASET_TITLES.get(ds, ds) + f"\n{int(n.n_families)} families, {int(n.n_models)} models, {int(n.n_targets)} targets")
    meta[ds] = dict(split=a.split, predictors=a.predictors, selectors=a.selectors, n_families=int(n.n_families),
                    n_models=int(n.n_models), n_targets=int(n.n_targets))
# One shared legend: methods + references actually drawn.
h, l = axs[0, 0].get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(h, l, loc="outside lower center", ncol=2)
print(style.save(fig, "fig2_main", a.out, dict(claim="C1", inputs={x: style.sha(x) for x in (p1, p2, p3, p4)}, panels=meta,
                                               draft=a.draft)))

def setup(width_in, min_pt, height_in=None, aspect=0.62):

        "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False,

        "legend.frameon": False, "figure.dpi": 150, "savefig.dpi": 300,
        "figure.constrained_layout.use": True,
    })
    return (width_in, height_in if height_in else width_in * aspect)


def save(fig, name, outdir, sidecar):
    """Write <name>.pdf and <name>.json (what the figure was computed on)."""
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    pdf = os.path.join(outdir, name + ".pdf")
    fig.savefig(pdf)
    sidecar = dict(sidecar, figure=name, generated=datetime.date.today().isoformat(),
                   width_in=fig.get_size_inches()[0], height_in=fig.get_size_inches()[1])
    with open(os.path.join(outdir, name + ".json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(sidecar, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str)
    plt.close(fig)
